title: 2.5 Alhambra Tour
text: We had a wonderful 2.5-hour tour of the Alhambra with Antonio Villalobos! He was incredibly knowledgeable about the history and shared so many interesting details throughout the tour. He spoke great English, was very friendly, and made the entire experience enjoyable and easy to follow. We learned so much and would definitely recommend Antonio Villalobos to anyone visiting the Alhambra!
author: lidad809

title: Tour by Mr. Carlos Serrano at the Alhambra
text: We are extremely satisfied and absolutely thrilled with the experience and the tour by Carlos Serrano! Many thanks and highly recommended!!! The Schilliger family
author: svetlanasR6782FU

title: Hector
text: The inside of the palace was beautiful as well as the gardens . Hector was an amazing guide who took time to explain the historical significance of each place and the meaning of the art in all the palaces . He was the most engaging and amazing tour guide we had in the whole trip. Kids loved the tour because of him
author: Jet230418

title: Perfect way to start the day!
text: Fernando was an excellent guide. He was knowledgeable, personable, and patient with all of our questions. I highly recommend a private tour with Fernando.

title: Amazing!

author: 428anabeleng

title: Unforgettable experience.
text:
Wonderful day, with the excellent and very knowledgeable guide Antonio Villajos, who told us about everyday life as it was 800 years ago. The work of the staff in the palace and the gardeners in the gardens. Antonio was very benevolent in his guidance throughout the trip. You were very inspired to listen to him. It meant that we borrowed books from the library and read about Alhambra after we came to Denmark.
We saw most of the fantastic views where there was plenty of opportunity to take pictures for memory.
